temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days, even during a busy and stressful week at the bank; when Carolyn asks, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and personal stuff.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging; her recent quietness is uncharacteristic and may mean something is wrong, though Carolyn does not know the cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn's response confirms she is struggling with work and personal stress, and she is willing to acknowledge it when asked.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is overwhelmed by work and personal issues, not simply being distant for no reason; Carolyn should be supportive and available.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer support and keep the door open for Marilyn to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn was curt in a later interaction, leaving Carolyn confused and hurt; when Carolyn shares her own tough experiences and apologizes for possibly overstepping, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is overwhelmed by work and personal stress; Carolyn had tried to be supportive, but Marilyn's curtness made Carolyn unsure whether she had overstepped or damaged things.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn's apology and explanation clarify that her curtness was due to a hard week, not necessarily to Carolyn's approach.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn's recent behavior is explained by personal and work stress; the misunderstanding can be repaired, and Carolyn's openness was appropriate and appreciated.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially confused and slightly hurt, then empathetic and somewhat relieved.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Clear any misunderstanding, show empathy by sharing her own experiences, and continue supporting Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded positively to Carolyn's openness, and when Carolyn invites her to a small weekend gathering, Marilyn accepts warmly and says she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn feels relieved and hopeful after the last conversation, believing they are building a friendship, though she likely wants to strengthen the bond further.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn's positive response and acceptance confirm reciprocal interest in a social and friendly relationship outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is interested in and receptive to Carolyn's friendship; their bond is developing positively.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Strengthen the friendship by hosting and inviting Marilyn to the gathering and building social connection.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn as still maintaining professional distance at the bank; when Carolyn raises it, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk and improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed their friendship was progressing and expected the work relationship to feel warmer, but she now perceives a professional distance from Marilyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn's response indicates the distance may be unintentional or at least something she is willing to address, rather than a rejection of Carolyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: There is a work-dynamic issue to clarify; Marilyn is open to improving collaboration, and the personal friendship may not automatically translate into workplace closeness.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and confused, then cautiously reassured and hopeful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Address the work dynamic directly, clarify expectations and boundaries, and work on improving collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they have cleared the air and understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; when she proposes teaming up for the new project proposal, Marilyn agrees enthusiastically and says she is glad they talked and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn is content and optimistic after the private meeting, believing they have cleared the air and reached a better mutual understanding of professional expectations and personal boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn's enthusiastic agreement confirms that the improved understanding is mutual and that collaborative partnership is welcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn and Marilyn have a stronger, more aligned working relationship; teaming up on the project is a good next step.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Propose and pursue the collaborative project to further their partnership.
